create_ebpf_map_for_flow_counting: create an eBPF map keyed by a Flow structure to count network packet flows
create_socket_filter_with_bpf_program: create a SocketFilter from a BPF program function and attach it to a raw packet socket
extract_flow_from_skb: extract source IP, destination IP, ports, and L4 protocol from an skb in a BPF program
iterate_ebpf_map_results: iterate over an eBPF map items to print TCP, UDP, and ICMP flow counts
convert_uint32_to_ipv4_string: convert a packed uint32 integer to a human-readable IPv4 address string using inet_ntop
